title: Warm request floor, measured end to end

host.note: load varies with the shared station; every client row is a median of 20, every syscall round trip is 5 samples, at the stated load

harness: /tmp/u9root: a real copy of the checkout's engine+project trees with .bl/sdks/current-sdk and a <64hex>/result-sdk symlink to the SDK, plus a held flock on .bl/sdks/preparation.lock and BL_SDK_REUSE_CURRENT=1. Reproduces the checkout client + realm, cold and warm, without building an SDK.

shell_start_to_launcher_exec.note: includes three fork+date instrumentation calls (~1.5-2 ms)

sampler.note: 1 ms stack sampler; ~26% of ticks had a running process during 20 warm requests

proposals.name: Per-tree generation cache outside the request process
proposals.change: Keep engine and project generation in a per-tree resident (or a daemon-owned cache): extend the digest cache to the project generation and gate it on the realm's own directory records, so an unchanged tree answers from a 64-hex token instead of restating 976 engine files and the project's recorded sources.

proposals.name: One request, one process: no per-request supervisor/child
proposals.change: Run the command in the connection process with a realm handle opened once per generation; write frames directly to the socket instead of through an io proxy; start the heartbeat only past a threshold; return the result on the same connection. Skip custody registration for an unchanged module set (U4's target).
proposals.note: 5 owned starts (~3.4 ms) plus their inner workers, realm.open 2.38 ms, io proxy + heartbeat 1.3 ms, execution registration ~0.9 ms, eval-module release 1.8 ms

proposals.name: Compact, keep-alive request
proposals.change: Persist the connection across commands (skip connect+hello, 1.2 ms); send argv + cwd + an environment generation/delta instead of the full 91-variable map (10,711-byte frame; client-environment allocates 58 lazy seq cursors, ~0.8 ms); cache the evaluated user file by source hash (run_file+eval_string 4.3 ms).

irreducible_estimate_ms.note: 1-2 ms is reachable with the three removals; ~1 ms requires no new client process per command (a resident client) and a VM path with no spawn and no realm lookup.
